cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Let Me Lean
cards.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Could you cancel our anniversary table? The restaurant number's on the fridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Please let the call be the first thing you take off me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call. They might ask whether you want another date.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say no for me. Then stay while I put the anniversary glasses away. You can tell me about your day.

mechanism: A delegates painful cancellation and company as approved tasks while withholding an explanation of the emotional weight.
confusable: D101 delegates beginning a difficult announcement; D97 more broadly shares the emotional load without naming how heavy it is.
comparison: An anniversary cancellation and putting glasses away differ from shared reading of a difficult letter.
seedUse: Use D97-a first task off A shoulders and B rescheduling question; keep the underlying event unnamed rather than inventing it.
